field.label: Supervise services
field.help: Select services to supervise with daemon(8) and restart after an unexpected exit. Attention: this can create additional pressure on a resource constrained system. Selected services must be restarted completely for changes to this option to take effect.

field.label: Restart retries
field.help: Maximum number of times daemon(8) restarts a terminated service before giving up permanently. Selected services must be restarted completely for changes to this option to take effect.

field.label: Restart delay
field.help: Seconds to wait between restart attempts. Selected services must be restarted completely for changes to this option to take effect.
